androidx.legacy:legacy-support-core-util.reason: Umbrella artifact under the "AndroidX support library" comment; it ships no classes the sources import directly.

androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-viewmodel-k.reason: Version pin for a transitive androidx.lifecycle; no Java or Kotlin source imports it. Consumer not identified — recheck when the androidx versions move.

androidx.work:work-runtime-ktx.reason: Version pin only. android/app/build.gradle:241 records it as the fix for a conflict between airship and react-native-plaid-link-sdk.

com.facebook.fresco:animated-gif.reason: Sole supplier of the animated-GIF decoder for React Native. Removing it breaks the animations rather than the build.

com.facebook.fresco:fresco.reason: Image pipeline React Native draws through; the app reaches it via React Native rather than importing com.facebook.drawee itself.

com.facebook.react:hermes-android.reason: Supplies the Hermes JS engine as a native library, loaded at runtime rather than imported; ReactAndroid declares hermes-engine compileOnly, so nothing else brings it in.

com.google.firebase:firebase-bom.reason: Platform BOM that aligns the Firebase versions React Native Firebase resolves; it declares no classes.

com.squareup.okhttp3:okhttp-urlconnectio.reason: Version pin only. android/app/build.gradle:244 records it as preventing a crash with react-native-plaid-link-sdk.
